primary.title: No Form 16 yet? 31 July ITR deadline is near—here's how salaried taxpayers can still file their income tax return
primary.summary: Form 16 makes return filing easier, but it is not the only document required. By reconciling salary records with Form 26AS, AIS, bank statements and investment proofs, salaried taxpayers can accurately file their returns even without Form 16.
